description: This file declares the RemoteControl class, which serves as a plugin for a larger framework, providing JSONRPC communication capabilities, handling remote control functionalities, and defining methods and event handlers related to remote control operations within the plugin.

classes.name: RemoteControl
classes.description: A plugin class implementing remote control functionalities and JSONRPC interfaces, inheriting from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Starts the pairing process for remote control devices.

methods.name: getIRCodesByAutoLookup
methods.description: Gets IR codes using auto lookup.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Gets IR codes by specified names.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Gets the source of the last keypress.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles IARM events related to the remote control.
